result:
All 617 tests pass and typecheck is clean. Summary of fixes made:

- **Project filtering hid entries** (`activity-service.ts`, `event.ts`, `comment-service.ts`): `issue.status_changed`, `comment.created`, and `comment.deleted` now carry the real `projectId` instead of `null`.
- **Assign entries misattributed** (`activity-service.ts`): `issue.assigned` now records the assigner (`payload.actorId`) instead of the assignee.
- **Missing activity types**: added listeners/direct `record()` calls for `project.updated`, `project.restored`, `issue.updated`, `issue.archived`, `comment.updated`, `comment.deleted`, `member.joined`, `member.removed`, `flag.toggled` (`activity-service.ts`, `project-service.ts`, `comment-service.ts`).
- **Wrong timestamps**: `record()` now accepts an `occurredAt` and every event-driven listener passes `payload.occurredAt` (the true event time) instead of stamping `new Date()` at write time.
- **Export capped at 100 / exclusive range**: `activity-repository.ts` now uses `lte` for `until` (inclusive range), and `exportActivity` in `activity-service.ts` paginates through every page instead of fetching one capped page. Also added since≤until validation to the schemas.
- **JSON export missing details**: `insertActivity` now persists the actual `metadata` JSON instead of hardcoding `"{}"`.
- Simplified `src/app/api/export/activity/route.ts` to delegate to `exportActivity` instead of duplicating (and under-fixing) the same export logic.
